scene: Mid-boarding on the captured merchant sloop's rail at sea: the Quartermaster (dark-brown wavy hair, light stubble, white shirt, dark-brown waistcoat) is the only pirate already over the side, one leg on the rail, a ledger clutched to his chest and a pistol tucked unused in his belt, eyes wide and sweating. Behind him in the rowing boat below, the Captain (black tricorn, full brown beard, burgundy long coat) and Tom (navy waistcoat, no hat) point him forward and stay seated. In front of him, the two captured merchant sailors stand with hands raised, frightened. Tension: he goes first, everyone else waits.

On the sloop's deck at dusk, the Quartermaster kneels over the open common chest, one mitten hand flat on the coins and the other holding his ledger, looking up in alarm as a ring of crewmates' mitten hands reaches in from every side. The Crewmate (black hair with a small tail, olive shirt) points accusingly at him, Tom peers over his shoulder counting on his fingers, and the Captain in the burgundy coat leans in with narrowed eyes. Tension: he holds everyone's money and nobody trusts him.
